scope: 核对实际 Bearer/body refresh；cookie 旗标不证明已支持 cookie。token generation、两 tab 成功/失败及原请求 actor 不越界。

maintainOrAdjustTransport.accessTransport: MAINTAIN: Bearer Authorization header injected from tokenStore localStorage per request (http.ts:31-37); consumed by authenticate() (rbac.js:56-115). No change proposed.
maintainOrAdjustTransport.refreshTransport: MAINTAIN: POST /auth/refresh JSON body {refreshToken}, raw axios bypassing interceptor (http.ts:92). No change proposed.
maintainOrAdjustTransport.cookieTransport: MAINTAIN_AS_UNSUPPORTED: no Set-Cookie/withCredentials in bounded source; CORS credentials flag is config not cookie auth. Explicitly document cookie is NOT a supported transport; do not infer support from deployment flags.
maintainOrAdjustTransport.configSelectors: MAINTAIN: VITE_API_BASE_URL, JWT_ACCESS_TTL/TTL_SEC, JWT_REFRESH_TTL remain transport-neutral config.

singleUseFamilyFailureSemantics.currentServerBehavior: refresh unconditionally revokes old token and creates a new random-family successor (auth.js:288-290). Under two-tab interleaving R02 recorded two successful successors (OBS-02).
singleUseFamilyFailureSemantics.recommendedChoice_OPEN: Named security/auth owner MUST select one of: (a) strict single-use — second refresh of an already-revoked/rotated family is rejected with a specific code (e.g. REFRESH_TOKEN_REPLAYED/STALE) and the surviving generation is the first successor; (b) relaxed family replay — both interleaved successors accepted transiently with documented duplication window. Server CAS/family-replay policy and client concurrency/retry window must be approved jointly (PC01 §合同).
singleUseFamilyFailureSemantics.failureCleanup: Refresh FAILURE cleanup must be lineage-owned: only clear storage if the failed refresh token/generation still owns current storage (fixes OBS-03 stale-failure erasing a successor).

required: Capture immutable initiating actor (userId) and session generation for every protected request and its refresh operation (fixes OBS-04/OBS-05).
Accept a refresh SUCCESS only if its originating session lineage is still current; an old success must never overwrite a later login or account switch (fixes OBS-04).
Apply refresh FAILURE cleanup only if the failed lineage still owns current storage (fixes OBS-03).
Replay ONLY under the initiating actor/session lineage. If identity changed, fail closed and do NOT send the original request with the new user's credential (fixes OBS-05).
frontendGenerationFenceAndReplayAttribut.recommendedFence: Attach initiating actor/session generation to the Axios request config at dispatch; the 401-replay branch re-reads the SAME captured generation and aborts if global generation diverged.

compatibilityAndFallback.maintainResponseHandling: 401 + AUTH_EXPIRED/INVALID_TOKEN triggers ONE bounded refresh (http.ts:129-134). 403 remains authorization denial, no clear/refresh (http.ts:153-154). Network/offline -> NETWORK_ERROR, no token clear, no auth-failure representation (http.ts:118-126). Keep as-is.
compatibilityAndFallback.defineSupportedTransportAndCompatWindow: Named approver records exact supported clients/transport, compatibility window, residual risks and approval date/evidence from evidence (PC01). CORS credential flags are NOT cookie transport support.

designChoiceStillRequired: Named security/auth/frontend owners select cross-tab coordination and fallback behavior (PC01 server CAS/family replay + client window).
Named security/auth owner selects refresh single-consumption, family replay/theft response, rotation retry/idempotency window, and failure recovery semantics.
Named frontend owner selects generation-fence storage shape (in-memory per-request config vs persisted session generation) and replay fail-closed trigger.
Named approver records exact supported clients/transport, compatibility window, residual risks and approval date/evidence.
D-S01-04 remains a SEPARATE pending policy gate (access JWT invalidation after password/reset/privilege change); T-RP-09 does NOT choose it.
